intro: Maur Raincaller is a tauren resident found residing in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Connected to the natural and spiritual life of the plains, he assists the village elders and watches over local matters affecting the herds and wild beasts.

p: Situated near the heart of Bloodhoof Village on the shores of Lake Stonebull, Maur Raincaller serves his community by attending to regional ecological and beast-related concerns. Like many who bear the mantle of Raincaller, he pays close attention to the balance of the elements and wildlife across the fertile plains of Mulgore. After a bite from the fearsome strider Mazzranache left his wound infected, Maur turns to capable young travelers to gather the animal parts he needs for a remedy.
